askAdmin: This is part of a paid plan. An administrator of the workspace can turn it on.

pitch.reporting_workspace: See how every meeting of the workspace is doing: engagement, attendance, plans followed through, actions closed, week after week, with a report by email.
pitch.compliance_auditLog: Know who changed what, and when: settings, people, roles and meetings, filtered, exported to CSV or streamed to your SIEM.
pitch.permissions_customRoles: Give exactly the rights people need: roles of your own on top of member and guest, for the workspace and every meeting.
pitch.identity_domainCapture: Your company's sign-in for your domain: verified domains, new accounts joining by themselves, single sign-on required, SAML, LDAP and SCIM.
pitch.reporting_portfolio: See the whole portfolio at a glance: the health of every project week after week, the due dates, the projects nobody spoke of lately, a CSV export and the projects to watch in the email report.
